stories.title: Consent Tier Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement core business logic enforcing two-tier consent rules, including gating of PHI storage, validation of tier transitions, and runtime checks before any data persistence or downstream service invocation.

stories.title: De-identification Pipeline Integration
stories.description: Integrate HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification into the consent workflow, ensuring all Tier 1 interactions are scrubbed of PHI before storage or logging, and validated prior to persistence.

stories.title: Lead Capture and Consent Integration
stories.description: Connect consent workflow with lead capture service to ensure Tier 2 consent is required for storing identifiable user data, including email and follow-up preferences, with duplicate detection preserved.

stories.title: Consent Audit Logging and Traceability
stories.description: Implement audit logging for all consent actions, including capture, upgrade, and enforcement decisions, with traceability to session and user context for compliance and debugging.
